mapper.select: select pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Type pType, pro.P_Name_History as pNameHistory, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, sec.Sec_Name as secName, c1.C_Name as dfUnitName, c1.C_Abbreviation as dfUnitAbbName, con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, mn.* from Design_Feasibility mn left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id=pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id=pro.P_Competent_Department left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=mn.Df_Id left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=mn.Sec_Id left join Sys_Company c1 on c1.C_Id=mn.Df_Unit where mn.Df_Id=#{dfId}
